name: APC regulator of Wnt signaling pathway

function.text: APC encodes a tumor-suppressor scaffold involved in the β-catenin destruction complex, helping restrain canonical Wnt signaling and regulate cellular organization.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to classic or attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis (autosomal dominant); gastric adenocarcinoma and proximal polyposis of the stomach (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Hepatoblastoma; Medulloblastoma; Pancreatoblastoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
